thread:
ada: quick ping urgent 1: we saw embeddings error spike during a heavy tail burst. I have a minimal fix (model-embed v2.3.7-stabilize). Need an express micro-deploy in the 00:40-00:45 UTC window.

noah: can you summarize the change and blast radius?

ada: single-file guard + adjusted eviction TTL. Affects embedding service only. Staging smoke + burst test passed.

lucy: PM ack, I'll prepare the release blurb once you paste a one-liner. Also need the exact deploy command.

ada: Deploy command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.7-stabilize --no-canary --note "hotfix: eviction guard + TTL"`

ops_oncall: I'll own rollback. Rollback triggers: embed_5xx_rate >1% sustained for 3m OR embed_error_rate >2% for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms. Also watch host OOM / autoscaler churn.

deploybot: Deploybot: slot open at 00:42 UTC. To execute run the pinned command. Confirmers required: @lucy @ops_oncall.

lucy: Approving expedited deploy for 00:42. I'll post external note after success.

releasebot: Releasebot: reminder to add changelog entry after deploy.

noah: quick preflight: `curl -X POST https://int-api/embed/smoke -d '{"version":"v2.3.7-stabilize","samples":150}'` -> 0/150 errors, p95 128ms (baseline 130ms).

ada: kicking off at 00:42. @deploybot please run pin. We'll do small staged rollout 5/50/100 with 60s watches.

deploybot: Started rollout 00:42 UTC. Steps: 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitoring hooks: embed_5xx_rate, embed_error_rate, p95_latency, host_oom_count. Live: https://deploys.internal/1801234567

ops_oncall: 5% step ok. No spike. p95 129ms.

noah: 50% step: brief spike in embed_error_rate on a single host to 1.1% (transient). Autoscaler cycled it, error subsided.

ops_oncall: holding at 50% for extra 30s to confirm.

ada: logs show guard prevented concurrent eviction. Good.

deploybot: Proceeding to 100% at 00:44 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy aggregate (10m): embed_5xx_rate 0.25%, embed_error_rate 0.5%, p95 latency 132ms. No rollback. Green check.

lucy: Published customer-facing note and updated changelog: "v2.3.7-stabilize: eviction guard + TTL tweak to reduce embedding failures under burst."

releasebot: Changelog entry created.

ada: thanks all. Filing a short follow-up ticket to add synthetic tail-burst test to CI and to bake this check into preflight.

noah: great quick turnaround. :rocket:
